_comment: Two packs the user added on 2026-08-15: 'Farm RPG FREE 16x16 - Tiny Asset
Pack' and 'MinifolksForestAnimals'. Both ship ANIMATION SHEETS, not sprites,
so every entry below is one frame lifted out of a grid.
Minifolks sheets are uniform 32x32 frame grids — every sheet width and all
but one height divides by 32, and index-atlas puts each animal's content
inside the first 32x32 cell. Frame (0,0) of each is taken. MiniBird is 64x48
Farm RPG rects are tight content boxes from index-atlas --gap=2. Its House
sheet holds TWO complete houses plus loose door/window/chimney props, and its
Maple Tree sheet holds two trees plus a sapling and a stump.
LICENCE: neither pack ships a licence file — checked, there is no .txt or
readme in either. Same gap HANDOFF §9.10 records for Pixel 16 and
TopDownFantasy_Forest. Worth saving the download URLs before this is
